adds.title: Births, Deaths and Marriages Registration Act 1999 amendments 2019 - gender-optional birth certificates
adds.summary: From 8 May 2019 Tasmania permits self-declared gender registration for Tasmanian-registered births with no medical certificate or medical document required, allowing persons aged 16+ to register male, female, indeterminate gender, non-binary or other self-described neither-entirely-male-nor-female gender via statutory gender declaration of identity and lived/seeking-to-live gender subject to Registrar refusal power for non-prescribed terms, allowing parents/guardians to register a gender for under-16s supported by the child's gender declaration where able or statements of consistency with will and preference plus optional counselling evidence where under 18, while birth sex registration remains male-or-female only and unchangeable except to correct initial error but ceases upon gender registration, and expands Anti-Discrimination Act 1998 protections to gender expression, gender identity including being transgender/transsexual and identifying/living as another gender, sex characteristics and variations of sex characteristics including as a ground for incitement-of-hatred prohibition.
